title: Two ARM64-specific compiler optimization bugs, in GCC 15/16 and Rust, hit curl
summary: Daniel Stenberg (curl creator) reports two ARM64-specific compiler optimization bugs—one in GCC 15/16 and another in Rust—that caused incorrect code generation affecting curl. These bugs demonstrate how compiler optimizations can introduce subtle but critical failures in production software.
problem_solved: Reports compiler optimization bugs causing incorrect code generation on ARM64 architecture that affected curl functionality
why_valuable: Highlights the importance of cross-platform compiler testing and the risks of relying on compiler optimizations in critical software like curl
